Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server: Burstable credit metrics in public preview

Body.Content:
The B-Series (Burstable) computer tier provides customers with the ability to monitor burstable credits. Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server offers two metrics to monitor burstable credit, “CPU Credits Consumed” which is the total number of burstable credits consumed and “CPU Credits Remaining” which is the total number of credits available to burst. You will be able to view these metrics from the metrics pane in the portal or programmatically through the Azure Monitor APIs.

Learn more.
